_comment: versionCode is the number Play counts uploads by. It must be higher than
the highest Play has ever accepted for com.phaserugbymanager.app, which
was 17 (1.2.9, the first Capacitor shell, 4 Sep 2026; 15 was the last TWA). Go up
by one for every upload, record what Play accepted here, and never reuse
a number. versionName comes from the root package.json.
billingLibrary is the Play Billing Library version PhaseBilling.java is
written against. Play refuses anything below 8.0.0 (learned 4 Sep 2026).
